en-US.description: Real-time system monitor with animated gauges, sparkline graphs, themes, alerts, and data export
en-US.longDescription: Real-time system monitor for Windows with animated gauges for CPU and GPU usage and temperature, sparkline graphs, 10 themes, compact mode, system tray, configurable alerts, CSV/NDJSON data export, and per-metric profiles. LibreHardwareMonitor is bundled for sensor access — no extra installs needed.
